name: smwgraphics-grand-dad-mania-midnight-city-zone
title: Grand Dad Mania - Midnight City Zone
description:
Here are some of the gfx from the Grand Dad Mania stage Midnight City Zone, it's enough to make you happy right?

It contains solid ground, platforms, pipes, supports, bridges, lamp posts, trash cans, and even TVs.

It might actually be from Mega Man or something but idk

Grand Dad Mania was made by Siivagunner fyi.
The video that these came from is this high-quality rip right here.

UPDATED: This now includes the BG of buildings in the background and a starry sky, as well as 16 more TVs! Along with this, you are free to make your own TVs and submit them. I also recommend using the Minimalist Status Bars patch to make sure you get a full view of the starry night sky. Enjoy!
